note.question: What determines the interplay between customer impatience and scheduling decisions when managing heterogeneous customer classes?
note.overview: This paper studies optimal scheduling of customers in service systems, such as call centers. In such systems, customers typically hang up and abandon the system if their wait for service is too long. Such abandonments are detrimental for the system, and so managers typically use scheduling as a tool to mitigate it.
